items.title: Alcide "Slow Drag" Pavageau Interview, 1958-12-10
items.q: it was my mother's sister's son, the oldest son

ctx.x: Oh, I don't know. And that's why my cousin, his name's Auguste, Auguste's name, Auguste is French, but he was playing in 28, playing bass. Was his name Pavageo? No, it was my mother's sister's son, the oldest son, yeah, Auguste's name was, you see. He used to play in 28, he used to play guitar and bass. And then he had a room in the back, but he wouldn't give his mama the key, I used to go up there clean, but he had his guitar to tune him, that's why I learned myself to play guitar.
